title_sq: Prane Shkolles Deshmoret e Lirise, Shitet Apartament 1+1, I Sapo Investuar!!
description_sq: Prane Shkolles Deshmoret e Lirise, Shitet Apartament 1+1, I Sapo Investuar!!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 5 (te fundit) te nje pallati ekzistues, si dhe ka nje siperfaqe neto prej 52.3 m2. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, dhoma e gjumit dhe tualeti. Apartamenti eshte i sapo investuar, me instalime elektrike/hidraulike te reja, vetrata dopioxham. Aktualisht jane duke u vene dyer te reja. Prona ka dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. Orientimi i prones eshte Jug. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje nder zonat me te kerkuara te Tiranes si dhe ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe te qete.
title_en: Near the Martyrs of Freedom School, 1+1 Apartment for Sale, Newly Invested!!
description_en: Near the Martyrs of Freedom School, 1+1 Apartment for sale, Newly Invested!!! The property is located on the 5th (top) floor of an existing building, and has a net area of ​​52.3 m2. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the living room together with the kitchen corner, the bedroom and the toilet. The apartment is newly invested, with new electrical/hydraulic installations, double-glazed windows. New doors are currently being installed. The property has regular mortgage documentation. The orientation of the property is South. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana and offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
